name: Rummy Olivo
sourceRevision: 2273843fe788fb68bfa35d80d9ec87b48f1d2b7e plus shared uncommitted central v28 fixes
scope: Dedicated Rummy audit using the preserved dossier, actual shared-engine fights, and this agent's own native T3 preview tab. Repository writes are limited to this report and tests/character-audits/rummy.test.ts. No runtime edits, art edits, commits, servers, or child agents were made by this auditor.

identityAndPortrayal.dossier: Venezuelan llanera singer; joropo cadence informs the fictional zapateo fighting style. Preserved research was used without new web research.
identityAndPortrayal.visualMatch: The photographed blue wide-brim hat, brown hair with light ends, patterned blue shirt, jeans and belt remain recognizable in all eight combat sprites. Brown boots are the dossier-approved combat adaptation. No likeness or wardrobe replacement was warranted.
identityAndPortrayal.audio: The dossier requests generic wordless effort/pain reactions and no real voice. src/game/reactions.ts defines generic actor banks explicitly unrelated to roster identities. No new dialogue or voice assets were created. Audio playback was not listened to in this audit.

movementAndStance.walking: Starting at x540, 24 right calls reach x652.9288778619349; the next 24 left calls reach x549.470815714616. Facing becomes +1 then -1 on either player side.
movementAndStance.jump: First jump reaches y454.6 after10 calls. Double jump is accepted, a third jump is rejected, and landing returns grounded=true, y554, jumps0 and two stocks on both sides.
movementAndStance.combatFrames: Production drawSprite inspected frame0 open-palm greeting, frame1 ready/block guard, frames2/3 running, frame4 tucked jump, frame5 open-hand strike, frame6 high kick, and frame7 recoil in both facings. Hat, head, fingers, boots and full silhouettes remain intact. No wrong-facing frame or neighboring shoe fragment was observed.

special.name: Zapateo llanero
special.distinctBehavior: Four radial floor contacts during a finite forward advance. Both actor and target must be grounded at contact. The final pulse has a stronger force8 push. No projectile is emitted.
special.fourConnectedSteps: After the510-tick intro, P1 Rummy x180 versus idle Javier x260, or P2 Rummy x900 versus Javier x820, special connects at attack ticks9/19/29/39, observed calls9/22/35/48 because hitstop pauses simulation ticks. Four hits reduce Javier to HP80.018 on either side (4*5*0.97*1.03 damage). The fourth contact applies force8. Radial contact can finish behind Rummy after her advance passes the opponent; this is the configured radial behavior.
special.idleAtGap180: All four floor effects emit at attack ticks9/19/29/39; first contact is out of range, then ticks19/29/39 hit. Both sides finish HP85.0135 with three hits, including the strong finisher. P1 advance ends x335.14285713527573 from180; P2 ends x744.8571428647242 from900. Velocity brakes below1e-6 after90 calls.
special.frontGuardAtGap180: Grounded guard toward Rummy blocks the three in-range pulses. Both sides retain HP100, record three block effects and zero Rummy hits. First pulse is outside range.
special.rearGuardAtGap180: Hold block while moving away (P1 rival right, P2 rival left), so facing points away from Rummy. Ticks29/39 hit on both sides with no block effects, HP90.009, including the stronger finisher. Movement changes which early pulses reach the opponent.
special.groundedRequirement: For each active attack tick9/19/29/39 on both sides, keep rival at initial gap500 until immediately before that pulse, then position rival80 pixels in front. Grounded control connects once. Increment real actor jump or target jump on that contact call: either independently prevents HP loss and attacker hits. Before collision both feet still share floor height; the input preparation sets the jumping actor/target grounded=false, isolating the flag check from vertical distance. Physics then moves the jumping character to y541.72.
special.isolatedFinisher: Fourth-pulse grounded control starts with targetHP100, hits for4.9955 damage and produces vx ±8.444044444444444 and vy -4.68 after that call's physics. Early pulse controls produce vx ±2.6387638888888887 and vy -1.105, confirming force2.5 versus force8.
special.energyGate: Energy24 rejects special; exact25 accepts and leaves0.035 after regeneration on both sides. Energy100 leaves75 immediately after activation.

attacksAndCombos.light: At gap80 on both sides, hits once for6.9937 damage, HP93.0063; forward guard preserves HP100. Outward knockback and proper hit/block effects were checked.
attacksAndCombos.heavy: At gap80 on both sides, hits once for12.9883 damage, HP87.0117; forward guard preserves HP100. Continued stepping does not create duplicate hits.
attacksAndCombos.baseCombo: Paso de sabana L→H connects both strikes with actual approach inputs on both sides; targetHP76.928, heavy bonus3,64 simulation ticks.
attacksAndCombos.advancedCombo: Flor de ritmo L→L→H connects all three strikes with actual approach inputs on both sides at wins1; targetHP65.8143, heavy bonus7,108 simulation ticks. At wins0, the same recognized input chain remains Paso de sabana with bonus3.
attacksAndCombos.inputRecognition: Separate setup probes let the two light inputs whiff at gap140 and verify the named/bonused heavy. This confirms the existing history recognition design independently of the fully connected combo checks.
attacksAndCombos.super: Zapateo final rejects wins0/wins2 with full energy and wins3 with energy74. It accepts wins3 with exact75 or100 and hits once at startup9/gap200 on both sides: (28*0.97+12)*1.03 damage, targetHP59.6652. The current super uses the shared close-range strike rather than a separate zapateo routine.

cpuFight.method: Complete510-tick intro; leave Rummy idle180 calls to exercise CPU offense; then use real approach, situational guard/jump, light/heavy/special/super actions. Compare two complete final MatchStates and recorded attack sets.
cpuFight.limitation: Rummy starts special in this bout without landing it; dedicated collision probes independently verify all four special contacts and guard/jump counters. This deterministic controller is an exercised fight, not a balance benchmark.

introAndSelection.name: Saludo llanero
introAndSelection.method: Opened a new tab with reuseExistingTab:false after preview_status. Imported production loadSprite/drawSprite/drawPresentation/renderMatch into an ephemeral canvas in this own tab. Inspected eight combat frames in both facings; intro/selection progress0/.3/.6/1 in both facings; actual renderMatch cinematic at tick84 for P1 and264 for P2; and fourth special contact at tick549 on both sides. No repository visual harness was written.
introAndSelection.observation: Intro and selection begin and end in ready guard. Midpoint opens the greeting palm with slight head/hand motion; intro adds a small hat accent and selection adds subdued floor rings. Hat and likeness stay coherent in both directions. The split-screen portraits face the rival on either side without apparent hand/head clipping. Fourth-pulse render shows the ground-ring/impact treatment and opposing outward reaction.
introAndSelection.oneShot: selectionProgress reaches1 at2800ms and remains1 at5600ms. Portrait schedules no further animation requests after progress1. Intro blocks movement/attacks until the shared510-tick timeline ends, with both fighters facing each other.
introAndSelection.transientLimitation: One ordinary lobby search click timed out after15000ms; the audit continued successfully through deterministic production renderer imports in the same native tab. No full interactive lobby-selection or keyboard-driven live browser fight is claimed.
introAndSelection.limits: Representative samples, not every animation interpolation frame. Audio playback and audiovisual synchronization were not assessed.

resolvedFindings.reproduction: Fresh createMatch poliedro Rummy/Javier, complete510 intro ticks; both energy100, grounded floor554, no rival input. P1 positions180/260 or mirrored P2 positions900/820. Increment Rummy special once, advance90 calls.
resolvedFindings.expected: Four grounded in-range contacts at attack ticks9/19/29/39; final contact uses force8.
resolvedFindings.before: Floor effects emit four times but only attack ticks9/29 hit, HP90.009. At ticks19/39 target is grounded and in range with two remaining invincibility ticks from the preceding hit; hurt's default12 exceeds the10-tick pulse spacing. Final strong push is suppressed at this close range.
resolvedFindings.centralResolution: Root added optional Technique.hitInvincibility, default12, passed for melee specials, and configured zapateo9. Auditor made no runtime change.
resolvedFindings.after: Fresh tsx process verifies both sides connect ticks9/19/29/39, HP80.018, and isolated fourth step force8. Both actor and target grounding checks still pass for every pulse. Regression asserts the intended four contacts rather than preserving the bug.

verification.runtimeRetest: Dedicated tests were run in fresh tsx processes after root's hit-invincibility fix, including the final exact75-energy super boundary.
notRun: Whole repository test suite or production build
verification.recommendation: Retain the centrally repaired four-pulse behavior and existing likeness/presentation. No remaining reproducible Rummy-specific defect was found in this focused audit.
